Chapter 276: Chapter 18: In a Hurry for a Century, Numerous Beings, All Watching One Person (Please Subscribe)_2

It is said that the cultivation environment in the Spirit Realm far surpasses that of the Central Divine Continent. In the Spirit Realm, the ancestors of the Daode Immortal Sect even included Unity Realm True Immortals.

“You should not have too many expectations for the ancestors,”

“The ancestors residing in the Spirit Realm find it difficult to intervene in the Lower Realms,”

Mu Qingliu shook his head. If the ancestors could intervene in Central Divine Continent, then the Demon Saint’s Nest, Nether Palace, and Blood Demon Sea would have been flattened long ago. How could they still exist today?

…

Baiyu Island.

...

Jun Dongjin, Mu Lian’er, Jun Xiaoyao, and Jun Zhilan.

They were anxiously waiting, speculating uneasily.

“Is this Baiyu Island?”

“The territory of Master Yuanyang? Does Wuji also have a connection with Master Yuanyang?”

The shock in Jun Dongjin’s heart never ceased.

Although he had vaguely guessed from Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit’s display of “Universe in the Sleeve” that his youngest son, Jun Wuji, might be far stronger than they imagined,

Yet until they received Jun Wuji’s personal confirmation, they could not be sure.

At that moment,

Lin Yuan appeared not far away.

“Wuji,”

“Younger brother,”

Mu Lian’er, Jun Zhilan, and Jun Xiaoyao ran over first.

“What exactly is going on?”

“The person who met us earlier, why does he look like you?”

Jun Zhilan couldn’t help but ask.

“That was one of my… let’s say avatars,”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment and explained.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path’s Martial Tao Primordial Spirit indeed resembled an “avatar,” only it did not require the same price as cultivating an “avatar.”

Next,

Lin Yuan disclosed everything truthfully.

Like his true strength, both the so-called Master Yuanyang and Ancient Saint Taiyin were his avatars.

As for why he possessed such power, Lin Yuan explained that in his childhood, some memories suddenly emerged in his mind.

Those memories contained some incomplete cultivation methods.

Anyway, it was mostly true, with a bit of falsehood.

“I have read in some ancient scriptures that before the appearance of the ‘Ascension Platform,’ those capable of exceeding the Void Refinement Limit faced the end of their lifespans and would attempt reincarnation,”

“Wuji, you must be the reincarnation of some powerful being. However, the theory of reincarnation is elusive and includes grappling with the mystery in the womb. That powerful being’s ‘true self’ might have already dissipated, leaving only some memories for you, Wuji, to take in…”

Jun Dongjin pondered for a while and then spoke.

Although the theory of reincarnation was elusive, it truly existed.

In the history of the Daode Immortal Sect, it had taken in some exceptionally precocious disciples.

These disciples were innately knowledgeable, and visions of another world would often flash through their minds.

“Young brother, are you saying that you just visited Mount Morality Immortal and almost breached it?”

Jun Zhilan blinked her eyes.

She understood every word Lin Yuan said, but when combined, why did it seem so alien?

“I took action against the Daode Immortal Sect with no ill intentions, only to prove my strength in preparation for spreading the Martial Tao,”

Lin Yuan stated truthfully.

If one wanted to spread the Martial Tao, relying solely on kinship and words was futile.

The Daode Immortal Sect had the backing of the “Spirit Realm” ancestors, so Lin Yuan never intended to eradicate Mount Morality Immortal.

After all, Lin Yuan could only stay in this world for five hundred years, and even if he did destroy the Daode Immortal Sect,

five hundred years later,

after Lin Yuan left this world, the Daode Immortal Sect’s “Spirit Realm” ancestors could easily make a comeback,

and reestablish the Daode Immortal Sect.

…

Even for a Unity Realm True Immortal, spanning two realms to break through world barriers and intervene in the Lower Realms is extremely challenging,

At most, they could employ some minor tricks. Such tactics might be sufficient to deal with ordinary beings who had surpassed the Void Refinement Limit, but against Lin Yuan, they were utterly ineffective.

However, with Lin Yuan present for the next five hundred years, there was no need to worry about the Martial Tao. But what about after five hundred years?

Thus, the real purpose of Lin Yuan’s actions was to force the hands of those ancestors from the Daode Immortal Sect in the Spirit Realm.

As for why he did not use more peaceful methods… such as speaking frankly with Mu Qingliu…

There really was no difference.

If Lin Yuan lacked sufficient strength, even if he appeared in a peaceful demeanor, he would still face suppression from the Daode Immortal Sect.

Conversely, if Lin Yuan demonstrated the ability to annihilate the Daode Immortal Sect in this realm, no matter what he did, as long as he did not cross a line, there would be room for negotiation.

Moreover,

Lin Yuan had another motive.

That was to avenge his parents.

It was the Daode Immortal Sect’s mistake in choosing the wrong person.

“Wuji, you do as you see fit,”

Jun Dongjin looked at his son and said,

Having experienced the peak and the potential of becoming the next Sect Master within the Daode Immortal Sect, as well as the lows, having spent a century at the remote Vast Cliff Mountain, he had seen through many things.

…

After explaining everything to his parents, elder brother, and elder sister,

Lin Yuan personally arranged a residence for them on Baiyu Island.

Baiyu Island brimmed with dense spiritual energy; even though it was not Mount Morality Immortal, it was a match for any paradise in the Central Divine Continent.

It was much better than the remote Vast Cliff Mountain.

With his parents cultivating here, Lin Yuan felt very relieved.

…

Several months later.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged inside his cave dwelling.

Nearby, a man in a blood-red robe bowed respectfully.

“I have seen you, my lord.”

This man in the blood robe was indeed the master of the Blood Demon Sea.

After spending several tense months in the Blood Demon Sea, he had decided to pay Lin Yuan a visit in person.

Given the strength Lin Yuan had shown, flattening his Blood Demon Sea was not a difficult task. Faced with such a powerhouse, the Blood Demon master naturally knew what to do.

“Is this one of your avatars?”

Lin Yuan looked at the Blood Demon master with keen interest.

He was not the first Ancient Saint to visit Lin Yuan.

Before him, the Ghost Cultivator King of the Nether Palace and the Demon Saint of the Demon Saint’s Nest had already visited.

They each had offered their core secret techniques in hopes of gaining Lin Yuan’s protection.

But to say they sought protection was not quite accurate; they merely hoped Lin Yuan would not strike against them.

Lin Yuan naturally accepted all of them with a smile.

These old Ancient Saints of Refinement Void who had lived for hundreds of thousands of years had many valuable secret techniques and teachings.

“My lord.”

“As my true body cannot leave the Blood Demon Sea, I had to send this incarnation…”

The Blood Demon master suddenly grew anxious, thinking that Lin Yuan was blaming him for being rude.

“Not to worry.”

Lin Yuan waved his hand.

“My lord, this is the ‘Immortal Blood Sea Skill’ I’ve been practicing for a long time…”

The Blood Demon master immediately presented a blood-colored jade slip.

He then pledged his loyalty to Lin Yuan, saying that if Lin Yuan commanded, he would expand the Blood Demon Sea, invade the Central Divine Continent, and battle the Daode Immortal Sect to the death.

…

After sending the Blood Demon master away,

Lin Yuan began to study the ‘Immortal Blood Sea Skill’ in the jade slip.

“To merge with the blood sea, immortal and indestructible; no wonder the Daode Immortal Sect has been unable to suppress it for hundreds of thousands of years. This skill already involves some techniques of the Unity Realm.”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned slightly solemn.

The Demon Saint’s Nest and the Nether Palace were able to withstand suppression from the Daode Immortal Sect up to this day because the Demon Saint’s Nest and the Nether Palace were powerful artifacts left by those who surpassed the Void Refinement Limit tens of thousands of years ago.

However, the Master of the Blood Demon Sea did not have these, relying solely on merging with the Blood Demon Sea to remain at large until now.

“Such technique, if only it could be slightly modified…”

Lin Yuan was rather tempted.

The flaw of the Immortal Blood Sea Skill was that one could not leave the item to which one was merged.

For example, the Blood Demon master could not leave the range of the Blood Demon Sea because he was the Blood Demon Sea and the Blood Demon Sea was him.

But with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, it was not impossible to eliminate this flaw, albeit at the expense of weakening the ‘immortal’ characteristic slightly.

…

Years passed leisurely.

A hundred years flew by quickly.

Baiyu Island became increasingly prosperous, and the number of Martial Dao Cultivators also grew.

In the Jun Dongjing territory, Mu Lian’er, Jun Xiaoyao, and Jun Zhilan had a happy and stress-free life on Baiyu Island.

And now, Baiyu Island’s reputation had surpassed that of the Daode Immortal Sect, further elevating the status of Jun Xiaoyao and Jun Zhilan.

Just then,

a terrifying aura burst from the core area of Baiyu Island.

The magnitude of this aura seemed capable of suppressing all things. Across the Billion-mile region of the East Sea, nature’s spiritual energy began to tremble.

The Demon Saint’s Nest.

The Demon Saint looked toward the direction of the East Sea in shock.

“Has that lord broken through?”

The Demon Saint murmured to himself. A hundred years ago, that lord had the ability to hang up the Daode Immortal Sect and beat it. With another step forward, what level would he reach?

…

The Nether Palace.

The Ghost Cultivator King sighed.

His gaze also turned toward the East Sea, pondering something.

…

The Blood Demon Sea and the Blood Demon master did the same.

…

The Daode Immortal Sect.

Mu Qingliu and Mu Mengting felt the aura from the East Sea immediately, sprang from their seats, and looked toward the East Sea.

…

As the breakthrough aura became more immense,

suddenly,

countless beings, as if sensing something, looked unconsciously toward the direction of the East Sea.

It was as if—

all the world, as one in gaze, watched a single man.
